domainWarnings.detail: liquidus_K: Named nominal-alloy fixed-front research approximation only; complete request chemistry/state retained. Explicit per-quantity convention/transfer disclosure required. No arbitrary composition inheritance. Al-9Si-0.6Mg to nominal AlSi10Mg: both Si9->nominal10 and Mg0.6->explicit requested Mg; impurities/state/rate transfer unquantified; no fitted correction

liquidus_K: Named nominal-alloy fixed-front research approximation only; complete request chemistry/state retained. Explicit per-quantity convention/transfer disclosure required. thermalConductivity: Kirchhoff mean of the sourced solid k(T) from preheat to liquidus held constant over the field; liquid and high-temperature state transfer
specificHeat: Kirchhoff mean of the sourced solid cp(T) from preheat to liquidus held constant over the field; liquid and high-temperature state transfer
density: nominal ambient density held constant over the high-temperature field
absorptivity: measured-conduction-as-built-surface at 1075 nm applied to a powder-bed track; optical surface transfer

validity.uncertaintyStatement: Uncertainty is unknown and may be large. Calibrate to your machine for better accuracy.
validity.explanation: Uncalibrated estimate: the average cooling rate is about 130000 K/s between 567 C and 185 C on the selected single-pass path. This cooling rate does not determine the final phases. Uncertainty is unknown and may be large. Calibrate to your machine for better accuracy.

uncertainty.construction: (Thi - Tlo) / (t(Tlo) - t(Thi)) per retained material path, weighted median; crossings bisected and checked at a finer step ratio; no interval.
